mapper.select: SELECT mo.move_id, item.item_name, sku.id skuId, sku.sku_name, mo.quantity, mo.source_storage_shelf, mo.target_storage_shelf, mo.unit_price FROM wms_movement_order_detail mo LEFT JOIN wms_item_sku sku ON sku.id = mo.sku_id LEFT JOIN wms_item item ON item.id = sku.item_id WHERE mo.move_id = #{moveId}
